name: table-value-then-date
text:
Age: 58
Sex: M
Component            Value     Date
Cholesterol, Total   197       08/13/2026
Cholesterol, HDL     37        08/13/2026
note: The standard Epic result table: value first, date last.

name: table-refrange-before-value
text:
Age: 58
Sex: M
Component      Ref Range     Value
Cholesterol    100-199       197
HDL            40-60         37
note: Some reports put the Ref Range column BEFORE Value. Without a guard the range's low bound (100, 40) becomes the result.

name: table-refrange-before-value-tabs
text:
Age: 58
Sex: M
Cholesterol	100-199	197
HDL	40-60	37
note: Tab-separated variant of the same column order.

name: table-value-flag-then-range
text:
Age: 58
Sex: M
Cholesterol, Total   197 (H)   100 - 199 mg/dL   Final
Cholesterol, HDL     37 (L)    40 - 60 mg/dL     Final
note: Value, abnormal flag, then the reference range.

name: egfr-range-not-split
text:
Age: 58
Sex: M
eGFR 60-89
note: A bare range must not be split apart into a bogus single digit; the low bound is reported and flagged.

name: egfr-legacy-race-rows
text:
Age: 58
Sex: M
eGFR NON-AA    72
eGFR AA        84
note: Older reports print two race-adjusted eGFRs; the first (non-Black) row is taken, matching the race-free CKD-EPI 2021 the tool uses.

name: egfr-ckdepi-label
text:
Age: 58
Sex: M
eGFR (CKD-EPI 2021): 68 mL/min/1.73m2
note: A descriptor in parentheses sits between the label and the value.

name: a1c-with-eag-annotation
text:
Age: 58
Sex: M
Hemoglobin A1c   6.1 (eAG 128 mg/dL)   4.3 - 5.6 %
note: The estimated-average-glucose annotation and the reference range are not the A1c.

name: abbreviated-lab-names
text:
Age: 58
Sex: M
CHOL 197
HDLC 37
LDLC 120
note: Terse lab mnemonics still resolve.

name: reference-lab-report-style
text:
Age: 58
Sex: M
CHOLESTEROL, TOTAL        197      mg/dL     100-199
HDL CHOLESTEROL            37 L    mg/dL     >39
note: An outside reference-lab report layout in all caps.

name: no-results-found
text:
Age: 58
Sex: M
No results found for: CHOL, HDL, LDL
note: An empty result set yields nothing.

name: pending-result
text:
Age: 58
Sex: M
Cholesterol, Total   PENDING
Cholesterol, HDL     37
note: A pending result is missing data, and must not borrow the HDL below it.

name: multi-date-rows-recent-first
text:
Age: 58
Sex: M
Cholesterol, Total   197   08/13/2026
Cholesterol, Total   220   02/01/2026
note: With repeated rows the most recent (first) is taken.

name: distractor-mrn-csn
note: Record identifiers are not clinical values.

name: distractor-phone-and-dob
note: A phone number is not a blood pressure, and a date of birth is not an age - the tool does not compute age from a DOB.

name: distractor-room-and-order-ids
text:
Room 14B Bed 2
Order 458923 Accession A9928374
Age: 58
Sex: M
note: Room, bed, order and accession numbers must stay out of every field.

name: distractor-other-vitals
text:
Age: 58
Sex: M
Vitals: T 98.6 F, HR 72, RR 16, SpO2 98%
note: Temperature, heart rate, respiratory rate and oxygen saturation are not PREVENT inputs.

name: distractor-basic-metabolic-panel
text:
Age: 58
Sex: M
Na 139, K 4.2, Cl 104, CO2 26, BUN 18, Glucose 102
note: A basic metabolic panel contains no PREVENT input; glucose is not an A1c and BUN is not a creatinine.

name: distractor-pain-score
text:
Age: 58
Sex: M
Pain score: 4/10
note: A fraction-style pain score is not a blood pressure.

name: distractor-height-weight-no-bmi
text:
Age: 58
Sex: Male
Height: 70 in
Weight: 205 lb
note: Height and weight alone do not yield a BMI, and neither number may be mistaken for one.

name: distractor-pack-years-alone
text:
Age: 58
Sex: Male
Social: 20 pack-years
note: Pack-years describe exposure history, not current smoking status, so the field stays blank.

name: distractor-full-note-header
text:
MRN 12345678  DOB 03/14/1968  Room 14B
Date of Service: 09/12/2026
Vitals: T 98.6, HR 72, RR 16, SpO2 98%
Na 139, K 4.2, BUN 18, Glucose 102
Meds: lisinopril 20 mg daily
note: A realistic note header full of distractors yields only the one real finding: the patient is on an antihypertensive.
